items.title: The last six months in LLMs in five minutes
items.whyItMatters: Simon Willison's concise H2-2025 recap — densely linked, covers evals and tooling shifts worth knowing before planning any new LLM feature.

items.title: Anthropic acquires Stainless
items.whyItMatters: Stainless auto-generates typed SDKs from OpenAPI specs; Anthropic owning the toolchain signals tighter SDK quality and a possible new standard for API client generation.

items.title: Show HN: Semble – Code search for agents that uses 98% fewer tokens than grep
items.whyItMatters: Semantic code search built for agent tool-call budgets — swaps grep's verbosity for embedding-based retrieval at 2% the token cost.

items.title: Apple Silicon costs more than OpenRouter
items.whyItMatters: Measured energy cost breakdown that flips the 'run it locally for free' assumption — useful data before sizing any self-hosted inference stack.

items.title: Linux security mailing list 'almost unmanageable'
items.whyItMatters: Concrete signal that AI-generated bug reports at scale break human review pipelines — a real constraint to factor into any agent-driven code-analysis workflow.
